legacy_analysis_notes.explanation: Any inherited RMS-matching limitation describes the unused legacy method; current factors are frozen fitting-candidate contrast ratios.

limitations: Development diagnostic; no efficacy or confirmation claim.
ActualU=0 yields degenerate BCA scores, not positive usefulness evidence.
RMS matching fixes fitting-bank magnitude, not information content or gradient strength.
Regret is restricted to the supplied candidate banks, not globally optimal control.
Frozen discrete reranking does not establish trained actor improvement.
Current-policy values may differ from the critic's smoothed lagged target-policy estimand.
Fitting/evaluation provenance, deterministic simulator and checkpoint authenticity are caller gates.
All 31 selectors and all 21 paired contrasts are reported; pointwise intervals are not multiplicity-corrected.
The four zero-penalty family entries duplicate raw Q1 selection and are not independent evidence.
Contrast matching equalizes a saved fitting-candidate magnitude, not gradient strength, information quality or development-state magnitude.
Fixed-factor contrast BCA is algebraically a prespecified effective-kappa rescaling at this checkpoint, not evidence that normalization is necessary.
No factor, kappa or winner is selected from these development labels; confirmation remains untouched.
